meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 GitHub 接进对话系统:用一个专门的机器人账号参与 PR 和 issue 的评论线程,被 @ 提及后在评论线程里回复,并继续响应该线程的后续评论。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人账号,且仓库已配好 webhook(订阅 Issue comments、Pull request review comments 等事件)时接管。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 渠道接进来,机器人账号叫 my-org-bot
say.note: 从 channels 分支拷贝适配器并注册

say.text: 这个仓库是公开的,接线时用 strict 策略
say.note: 只有已注册成员能触发 agent

say.text: PR 和 issue 用 per-thread 会话模式
say.note: 每个 PR/issue 各自独立会话

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects GitHub into the chat system: a dedicated bot account takes part in PR and issue comment threads, replying when @-mentioned and then answering follow-up comments in that thread.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment, with a repo webhook subscribed to issue comments and PR review comments events.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel, my bot account is my-org-bot
say_en.note: copies the adapter from the channels branch

say_en.text: This repo is public, wire it with the strict policy
say_en.note: only registered members can trigger it

say_en.text: Use per-thread session mode for PR and issue threads
say_en.note: each PR or issue gets its own session
